title: Noah-MP: Global Climate Infrastructure
summary: Yang's Noah-MP model has become critical infrastructure for weather and climate prediction worldwide, used by NCAR, NOAA, and the National Water Model.
keyPoints: Adopted by major U.S. modeling centers
Used in Community Earth System Model

title: Hurricane Harvey: Real-World Validation
summary: Yang's models proved their value during Hurricane Harvey, accurately forecasting extreme rainfall and flooding that devastated Texas.
keyPoints: Accurate prediction of extreme weather events
